summary: A strong act-break beat: the threat arrives visually, Hassan identifies the reversal, and his restrained fire-control order establishes competence under life-or-death pressure.

lines.speaker: HASSAN

performance.delivery: Keep his body still and his eyes on the approaching infantry. He quietly confirms the feared move to his men, then makes the final sentence a firm fire-control order.

lines.text: جُمْ مِنْ وَرَا… زَيّْ مَا قُلْنَا. مَحَدِّشْ يِضْرَبْ قَبْلِي.
